title: CPB offering parameter schema
description: An attributed parameter contract for one model offering. An observed schema preserves the acquired schema; a supported schema declares the pack owner's selected scope. The offering's schema_snapshot names this file; model_id, service, model_identifier and observed_at repeat the model record and offering.

model_id.description: The id of the model record whose offering names this file.

observed_at.description: The date the schema was acquired, as the acquisition records it.

schema.description: The acquired parameter schema for observed artifacts, or the authored supported parameter schema for supported artifacts.

selection.description: The source identity and authored scope of a supported parameter contract. The source digest identifies the acquisition; it does not prove the selected contract was returned by the service.

source_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the acquired schema serialized with execution_contract.encoded.
